reviewItem.question: Does "The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=cluster-name-validation (validation-tightened)?

proposed.statement: Cilium cluster name is now validated (max 32 lowercase alphanumerics or '-', starting and ending alphanumeric); bypass via upgradeCompatibility v1.15 or earlier, strictly enforced from v1.17.
